description_en: Creates a VPC tunnel and adds 1 to 20 tunnel routes at the same time for Edge Security Acceleration (ESA) back-to-origin access to cloud resources in the VPC. The creation is an asynchronous operation. The API returns the init status. You can call GetVpcTunnel to query the status. A status of active indicates that the creation is complete
description_zh: 创建VPC隧道并同时添加1~20条隧道路由，用于ESA回源访问VPC内的云资源。创建为异步操作，接口返回init状态，可调用GetVpcTunnel查询，Status为active表示创建完成
name: CreateVpcTunnel

parameters.help_en: The name of the VPC tunnel. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, start with a letter, and contain only letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens
parameters.help_zh: VPC隧道名称，1~128个字符，以字母开头，可包含字母、数字、下划线和中划线
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description. The description can be up to 512 characters in length
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en: The description. The description can be up to 512 characters in length
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The identifier of the cloud resource. For ECS, ALB, NLB, CLB, and ENI, specify the instance ID, which can be up to 128 characters in length. For OSS, specify the bucket name, which can be up to 128 characters in length. For IpTarget, specify the destination IP address in the VPC, which can be up to 64 characters in length. For VpcDomain, specify the resolvable domain name in the VPC. For RDS, specify the internal network endpoint of ApsaraDB RDS, which can be up to 256 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 云资源标识。ECS、ALB、NLB、CLB、ENI为实例ID，最长128个字符；OSS为Bucket名称，最长128个字符；IpTarget为VPC内的目标IP，最长64个字符；VpcDomain为VPC内可解析的域名，RDS为RDS内网连接域名，最长256个字符
fields.name: endpoint

fields.help_en: The region where the cloud resource resides
fields.name: region

fields.help_en: The type of the cloud resource
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The list of vSwitch IDs. For IpTarget, VpcDomain, and RDS, you must specify 1 to 8 vSwitch IDs, each 1 to 64 characters in length. For other types, you can only omit this parameter or pass an empty array
fields.help_zh: VSwitch ID列表，IpTarget、VpcDomain、RDS必填1~8项，每项1~64字符；其它类型仅允许省略或空数组
fields.name: vswitchids

fields.help_en: The VPC ID. This parameter is required only when Type is set to IpTarget, VpcDomain, or RDS
fields.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The list of tunnel routes. You can specify 1 to 20 routes
parameters.name: routes
